evidence.title: CSS Cursors — 39 custom cursor effects, free to copy

name: CSS Cursors
summary: Library of 39 custom CSS cursor effects you can preview, copy as code or recreate with an agent prompt.
description: A collection of 39 custom cursor effects — magnetic rings, difference-blend discs, comet trails, gooey metaballs, radar reticles and more — each pure CSS driven by a ~20-line universal pointer tracker that only writes --x, --y, --angle and --speed. Hover a tile to try a cursor, click to copy its self-contained code or a ready-made prompt for your coding agent; everything respects prefers-reduced-motion and the collection is MIT licensed.
contains: pure CSS plus a ~20-line JavaScript pointer tracker
click to copy self-contained code or an agent prompt
